diagnostics.message: EventBridge can invoke the syncer Lambda, but this target has no ordering dependency on the Lambda permission that grants EventBridge invocation access. Ensure the permission exists before registering the target to avoid an invocation failure.
EventBridge can invoke the scale-down Lambda, but this target has no ordering dependency on the permission granting EventBridge access. Ensure the permission exists before registering the target.
EventBridge can invoke the pool Lambda, but this target has no ordering dependency on the Lambda permission granting EventBridge access. Ensure the permission exists before registering the target.

The SQS event-source mapping can begin polling the queue, but it has no dependency on the scale-up Lambda execution-role policy that grants the required SQS access. Order mapping creation after that policy to avoid polling before permissions are available.
